deliverables: WP1 - Plutarch and Ply Maintenance, Compatibility & Developer Experience
Critical breakages and serious vulnerabilities response
Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: Intersect on behalf of MLabs / vendor, with funds directed to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.
request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of Plutarch and Ply, including compatibility, bug fixes, optimizations, documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements.

claims.claim: Plutarch is a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply serializes Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.
MLabs states that Plutarch and Ply have been used throughout the Cardano ecosystem and that a recent internal audit counted at least 26 teams using them.
The rationale separately states that MLabs conservatively counted at least 15 teams building with Plutarch and Ply.
MLabs claims public cross-language benchmarks show Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in the benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.

The proposal says the requested funding will help keep Plutarch and Ply reliable, compatible, and useful as Cardano ledger, Plutus, and tooling evolve, including possible Dijkstra-era compatibility if relevant changes land during the funding period.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states the 1,162,746 ada request does not, alone or in aggregate at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The budget summary allocates 1,128,880 ada to Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience, plus a 33,866 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The document discloses prior MLabs treasury and ecosystem funding, including listed governance actions, Catalyst Fund9 and Fund13 awards, and 70,000 ada from Intersect for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

The proposal says funds will be managed through Intersect's 2026 treasury smart contract framework with TRSC and PSSC addresses, defined multisignature permissions, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for annual Plutarch and Ply maintenance and enhancement, routed through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts, with stated Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, prior funding disclosures, and external references for voting, audits, contracts, and tracking.
